base_color.description: RGBA color multiplied into the rendered model or primitive.

texture.description: Project-relative diffuse/albedo texture path. Kept as an alias for albedo.

orm_texture.description: Project-relative packed occlusion/roughness/metallic texture path. R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic.

roughness_texture.description: Project-relative roughness texture path. The red channel is sampled.

metallic_texture.description: Project-relative metallic texture path. The red channel is sampled.

ao_texture.description: Project-relative ambient occlusion texture path. The red channel darkens ambient light.

height_texture.description: Project-relative height texture path for parallax mapping. The red channel is sampled.

mipmaps.description: Generate mipmaps before applying the texture filter.

lod_bias.description: Positive mip LOD bias for noisy textures; higher values sample softer mip levels.

lighting.description: Whether the material participates in r3d lighting.

metallic.description: Lit material metallic response from 0 to 1.

height_scale.description: Parallax height scale from 0 to 0.2. Small values around 0.02-0.05 are recommended.
